maintenance_led.reason: Mainly recurring rental of uniforms, mats and restroom supplies, with laundering and delivery; not repair of customer-owned installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private businesses in manufacturing, automotive, food, healthcare and hospitality; municipalities are a small share.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through route-based uniform rental and facility services sales, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Uniform rental and facility supplies can be changed to another rental provider; switching is a hassle but not high-risk.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call: switching involves garment changeover and sizing but little regulatory or downtime risk.
